facts.business: Rain Industries Limited operates in the Carbon, Advanced Materials, and Cement segments, producing calcined petroleum coke, coal tar products, advanced materials, and cement.
key_risks: Volatile raw material availability (green petroleum coke, coal tar)
Dependency on single suppliers for critical raw materials
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
